elements.title: Product Life Cycle - Recover
elements.content: A circular diagram showing five life cycle stages: DESIGN AND SOURCE (recycling icon), MAKE (solar panel icon), PACKAGE AND SHIP (globe icon), USE (plant icon), and RECOVER (hand holding plant icon). The RECOVER stage is highlighted.

elements.title: Apple Trade In
elements.content: For more information on how to recycle your products at end of life, visit: apple.com/recycle
